comparison.objective: Retrieve a pack from a constrained chest freezer, versus commission and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Reach planning under a partly blocked lid and object extraction versus fine tool alignment, controlled rotation, locking torque, and physical cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Pack retrieved without stated obstruction failures versus two safe, repeatable stops within quantified limits.
comparison.reason: Constrained retrieval is unrelated to damping adjustment. Body and specs are absent, so retrieval safety and contact thresholds are missing.
